cohort: The study included 120 pregnant women undergoing cesarean section, divided into three groups based on whether they received ondansetron, granisetron, or no antiemetic premedication.
finding: High dose granisetron (3mg) was superior to low dose ondansetron (4mg) and the control group in preventing spinal anaesthesia induced hemodynamic fluctuations in obstetric patients undergoing cesarean section.
